name: Ghost of Yotei
summary:
The game takes place 300 years after Ghost of Tsushima. Set in the lands surrounding Mount Yōtei, a towering peak in the heart of Ezo, an area of Japan known as Hokkaido in present day.

The area is outside the rule of Japan, and filled with sprawling grasslands, snowy tundras, and unexpected dangers.

name: Hitman World of Assassination: VR Access
summary:
Become the ultimate HITMAN in VR.

Walk in the crowded streets of Mumbai, explore the corridors of a Parisian palace, or stalk your target through the jungles of Colombia, in VR these environments become worlds you inhabit.

Imagine standing in the center of a bustling marketplace, feeling the energy of the crowd around you, or peering through the scope of a sniper rifle, your heartbeat syncing with the pulse of the trigger. Every moment feels more intense and personal.

With NEW INTUITIVE CONTROLS, interact with the world around you, use your hands to perform every action, and feel the tension of every mission.

Jump into thrilling action with DUAL-WIELDING, allowing you to hold weapons in both hands.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Gold Edition
summary:
The crown jewel of every noble’s chest: it’s got everything, whether you’re a Kingdom Come: Deliverance aficionado or newcomer to the series.
The Gold Edition of Kingdom Come: Deliverance II contains the standard edition, Expansion Pass and the Gallant Huntsman’s Kit.

name: Liar's Bar
summary: Liar's Bar is a 2-4 player multiplayer deception game set in a shady bar where bluffing and outsmarting your opponents is key to survival. Play Liar's Dice or Liar's Deck, choose from unique characters, and engage in high-stakes games where every lie could mean life or death. Outsmart your rivals, survive deadly rounds, and see if you can be the last one standing!

name: Savara
summary: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!

name: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark
summary: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark is a 2D action adventure starring two new characters. Servants of the Dark takes the tight action players enjoyed in Gal Guardians: Demon Purge and vastly increases the exploration and collection elements, shifting genres completely to a full Metroidvania for an all-new experience.

name: Mech Havoc
summary: Fight against hordes of Evil Robots to safe the world! Control powerful machines! From building sized Mechs to nimble Delivery Trucks. Unlock new weaponry and demolish your enemies (and buildings) using Artillery Strikes. Or gain extra firepower with deployable Turrets.

name: Stario: Haven Tower
summary: Build a vertical city in a world of a tower. Lead the dwellers to gather resources from the sky and build upwards. Make vertical transport and climbs up. Explore the creatures and sceneries in higher skies.

name: Inayah: Life after Gods
summary: INAYAH - Life After Gods is a thrilling action-platformer with metroidvania elements. Immerse yourself in a story with multiple choices, explore diverse biomes, face more than 20 bosses, and develop your character with a unique progression system.

name: Cladun X3
summary:
The third numbered entry in the Cladun series.

Cladun X3 is a highly customizable and dynamic pixel art action RPG with a focus on hack-and-slash gameplay. Utilize a variety of weapons, magic, and actions to fend off the monsters monsters and traps that await you, and clear the dungeons!

name: Drop Duchy
summary: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

name: Hirogami
summary: Explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. Embark on a mystical journey to save your fragile home from deadly digital invaders. Take on animal forms to traverse the landscape, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and save the realm.

name: Age of Mythology: Retold - Immortal Pillars
summary:
Unleash the power of Chinese mythology in Age of Mythology: Retold’s first expansion, Immortal Pillars. Discover a new pantheon of gods, legendary myth units, and awe-inspiring god powers in an epic campaign inspired by ancient legends.

Summon the fierce goddess Nüwa, command Chiyou, the bull-headed god of war, and call upon Nüba, the relentless bringer of drought. Control the skies with Yinglong, the mighty flying rain dragon, and experience so much more.

name: Netherworld Covenant
summary: In the abyss where the mortal realm and netherworld intertwine, becoming a warrior wielding the power of the Ethereal Torch to fight along with the fallen souls. With hardcore action and intriguing roguelike builds, shatter the cursed barriers and unveil the truth woven from blood and soul.

name: Storage Hunter Simulator
summary: Bid, win and then sell for profit as you work your way up from the bottom to become the king or queen of the storage auction. Take risks and fight for garages amongst fierce competition as you compete with other bidders to find hidden treasures that will help you turn a profit.

name: City of Nightmares
summary: You are a detective who wants to investigate how all the inhabitants of a city died due to a virus. It all started in a hotel that was abandoned along with the city, and it was rumored to be haunted. You are on a quest for answers.

name: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & The White Guardian
summary: A mainline Atelier game that's completely offline, standalone, and without gacha elements. This mainline entry sticks to the longtime traditional Atelier series gameplay experience while also building upon it. Atelier fans can enjoy an evolution of the familiar Synthesis and Turn-based Battle systems, culminating in a heartwarming story for all to enjoy. A separate original title set in the same world of the "Atelier Resleriana" gacha game awaits from developers Gust & Team Ninja.

name: Sultan's Game
summary: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

name: Venus Vacation Prism: Dead or Alive Xtreme
summary:
On this island, the moment of love.

The first ever full-fledged first-person adventure romance game in the DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme series, offering romantic encounters with six cute, charming girls!

name: Devil's Drizzle
summary: An enchanting 2D pixel art platformer with an engaging story, starring a brave kid, their trusty umbrella, and Sumerian demons. It features a diverse range of mechanics and level designs, including action, adventure, horror, puzzle, and drama.

name: Heroes of Valor
summary: This is war, soldier. Pick a class, gear up, and hit the front lines. Whether you're storming beaches, piloting fighters, or holding the line with your squad, your orders are clear: fight hard, fight smart, and never back down. Enlist now! Become a Hero of Valor today!

name: Jin & Jan
summary: Jin & Jan: A ghostly puzzle game for two minds but only one player. Control two brothers, Jin and Jan, on a spooky adventure. Jin does what you say, but Jan always does the opposite! Master their unique movements to solve mind-bending puzzles and overcome obstacles in a ghostly world.

name: Bokura: Planet
summary: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Safe Haven
summary:
Brace yourself for the darkest chapter yet in the epic Poppy Playtime saga.

You are pushed deeper into the undiscovered depths of the Playtime Co. factory, far below anything the world knew. Here, you’ll encounter terrifying new threats and discover shocking revelations. Can you outwit the unnatural new creations lurking in the shadows? Can you survive here long enough to eventually unravel the mysteries behind the experiments? Every step will test your courage, every puzzle will challenge your mind, and every corner may be your last.

Will you escape the horrors hidden within Playtime Co., or will you succumb to the terror? Survival isn’t guaranteed. Fear is.

name: Petrified Pawns
summary: Petrified Pawns has chess-style movement and turn-based combat. Fight new types of chess pieces and bosses. Build your army and keep them alive while you advance through the dungeon. Use healing spells, loot and strategy to keep your king alive and to reach the end with as many units as possible.

name: Curiosity
summary:
"Curiosity killed the cat, But satisfaction brought it back."

Play as a cat as you leap and climb through a perilous labyrinth of obstacles, all to find your way back home.

name: Small Spaces
summary: Small Spaces is a relaxing game about turning small apartments into beautifully designed dioramas you'd want to live in. From a simplistic flat in Tokyo to a victorian townhouse in San Francisco. Your only limit is the space itself.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog: Borderline
summary: Sonic the Hedgehog: Borderline is a ROM hack of the original 1991 Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Genesis. The project reimagines South Island through a narrative set after the events of Sonic Mania Plus, where Dr. Robotnik uses a portal and the Chaos Emeralds to build "Robotnik Land," a machine threatening to awaken an ancient monster in the Earth's core.

name: Inkshade
summary: Inkshade is a turn-based tactics game carved out of strange wooden miniatures, wrapped in a web of locked rooms, and orchestrated by an otherworldly game master. Victory is not guaranteed, and the only constant is the cruel black ink that flows within the pieces.

name: Pieces of Me
summary: Pieces of me is a psychological thriller drama in the genre of "walking simulator", which is a spin-off to the game "September 7th"

name: Verho: Curse of Faces
summary: Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude, where masks have become the only protection against the Curse of Faces. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.

name: Nubs! Arena
summary: Slap yourself into the absurdity of Nubs, where 5-player battles are as chaotic as they are quick! Risk it all for the mighty Konzumos' delight in this arena brawler and smash the others to nublivion in your quest for glory! Simple rules? Check. Roguelite progression? Sure. Predictability? No way!

name: Cube Snake
summary: Slither through a retro-futuristic cyberpunk world in this 3D Cubic take of the classic 1976 & 1998 Snake games.

name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
summary: "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate" is a side-scrolling beat'em up with the heart of a fighting game, supporting cross-platform pixel art anime action with up to 8P online multiplayer and all the characters from "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive"!

name: Sunderfolk
summary: Sunderfolk is an online and couch co-op turn-based tactical RPG where one to four players adventure together through the magical and dangerous Sunderlands.

name: Star Wars: Episode I - Jedi Power Battles
summary: Take back the Theed Royal Palace in this fast and furious lightsaber action game. You will have the power of the Force and your trusty lightsaber to help you ward off legions of battle droids, destroyer droids, assassins, and other creatures from Star Wars: The Phantom Menace.

name: Playtown Genesis
summary: A stealth-based adventure set in the 1960s where you play as Doctor Clint, navigating the dangerous corridors of a secret underground facility. Outsmart guards, avoid detection, and team up with rebels to bring down a brutal regime.

name: Identifile
summary:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

name: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
summary: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!

name: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game
summary: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a bloody retro fighting beat em up with frenetic action and a lot of fun and references to the Terrifier franchise.

name: Little Fighter 2 Remastered
summary: Rediscover the classic combat charm of "Little Fighter 2," now with fully upgraded and redrawn graphics, support for local connections up to 8 computers, and every character move more detailed and extravagant, providing an unprecedented combat experience.

name: Tomb Raider IV•V•VI Remastered
summary:
Remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy includes:

Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation – Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

Tomb Raider: Chronicles – Following the events of The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is buried in an Egyptian tomb and is presumed dead. At her memorial, those closest to her reminisce about secrets from her past.

Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness – Accused of murder, Lara becomes a fugitive on the run, while uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving alchemical experiments and the search for ancient artifacts.

name: Blood of Mehran
summary: In Blood of Mehran, explore sweeping sand dunes, bustling bazaars and sprawling palaces. Go blade to blade with enemies, pick them off from a distance with your arrows, or slip by them like a ghost. Level up and build your legend.

name: The Spiral
summary: The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. To survive, you must descend into darkness and confront the nightmares within. Explore the randomized dungeon, find powerful equipment, and fight for your life.

name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

name: True Nightmare: Roadside Сafe
summary: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a night-shift waitress at a secluded roadside café, serve strange patrons and feel mounting dread. Each night, the nightmare becomes more real, and someone is watching from the darkness. Can you survive?

name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
summary: Dive into Ayasa, a dark and mysterious platformer where light and shadow hold the key to survival. Journey through six haunting lands, solve challenging puzzles and restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.

name: Rogue Piñatas: VRmageddon
summary: A multiplayer VR roguelite game. Your mission? Survive the party-apocalyptic world by bashing your way through swarms of invading Piñatas, where every swing could mean survival or sweet defeat!

name: License To Clone
summary: Survive a harsh desert with sci fi technology, rampant wild clones and multiple factions. Start off working in a small town for any faction, grow your money and eventually start your own town, complete bounties to earn faster cash and progress.

name: Tron: Catalyst
summary: The Arq Grid stands on the brink of collapse. With your Identity Disc and Light Cycle, fight to escape by wielding the power of the Glitch loop. Electrifying action and a rich story combine in a new adventure set within Disney’s iconic TRON universe.

name: Dicealot
summary: A roguelike dice roller with deckbuilding elements

name: Navicula Meatus
summary: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.

name: Spirit X Strike
summary:
An Action Adventure Game that lets you craft unique COMBOs and explore endless ways to style on your enemies with a high-speed combat system. Test your skills in fun chaotic one-vs-group battles, intense, strategic duels, and exhilarating post-apocalyptic adventure that will set your blood boiling.

Experience a fresh take on this action adventure of "Spirit X Strike," featuring three intertwined combat systems: Instant Counter, Super Strike, and Spirit Mimicry. Players can swiftly switch between defense and attack, and experience an adrenaline-pumping combat.

name: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
summary:
A remaster of the original Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation, including The Times Exclusive Playable Level as well as the ability to toggle between original and remastered graphics.

Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

name: Tomb Raider: Chronicles
summary:
A remaster of the original Tomb Raider: Chronicles and the ability to toggle between original and remastered graphics.

Following the events of The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is buried in an Egyptian tomb and is presumed dead. At her memorial, those closest to her reminisce about secrets from her past.

name: Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness
summary:
A remaster of the original Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness and the ability to toggle between original and remastered graphics.

Accused of murder, Lara becomes a fugitive on the run, while uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving alchemical experiments and the search for ancient artifacts.

name: Destiny: Rising
summary: Enter an era of heroes and legends set within the rich tapestry of the Destiny Universe, where you will meet both familiar faces and intriguing new characters. Experience top-tier sci-fi shooting action in the franchise’s first mobile game as you embark on a new adventure in an alternate Destiny timeline. Play as these unique characters to defend future Earth and reclaim humanity's future!

name: Achilles: Survivor
summary: Achilles: Survivor is a dynamic single-player bullet heaven game where you face thousands of enemies, build destructive structures, develop your character to return as an even more powerful machine of destruction and survive waves of enemies.

name: Carnival Massacre
summary: Drawing heavily from classic survival horror tropes, Carnival Massacre takes players on a haunting quest in a cursed theme park. Explore your surroundings, manage your messy inventory, solve puzzles and kill the four ringleaders of the park.

name: Terrorbytes
summary: Collect pellets to power the safe room and survive. Solve the mystery of how you were sucked into this haunted arcade machine, and escape.

name: Of Lies and Rain
summary: Of Lies and Rain is a story-driven first person shooter built exclusively for VR. Set in a dark, sci-fi, post-apocalyptic world, at the edge of the real and digital realm. You’ll fight to reclaim your past and save humanity from the brink of extinction.

name: AmaZoo
summary: AmaZoo is a progressive and varied puzzle game, inspired by the classic video game Sokoban, but presented in side-view, like the old classic 2D games. In this game, you can solve a multitude of puzzles and put your logical mind to the test, moving and organizing different types of boxes to reach the exit and progress to the next stage. But be careful— some boxes are fickle, and watch your step!

name: SWAT Commander
summary: In SWAT Commander you take charge of an elite special forces unit. Issue orders to your squad, manage its members and their equipment, but most importantly – complete your objectives successfully. Follow your operatives into a number of high-risk missions that will test your tactical abilities.

name: RailGods of Hysterra
summary: Embark on a co-op survival journey for 1-5 players through a post-apocalyptic Lovecraftian world! Command and evolve a living, monstrous train, craft weapons, build a mobile base, gain powers, and face the Great Old Ones. Explore an ever-changing world, hold on to your sanity, and ascend to godhood!

name: Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator
summary: Transform your passion into profit with Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator! Design, build, and manage your own sustainable hydroponics system. Experiment with different plants and fish, customize your setup, and harvest your success. Dive into the future of farming today!

name: Cronos: The New Dawn
summary: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

name: FBC: Firebreak
summary: FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order.

name: Bad Cheese
summary: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

name: Gloomy Eyes
summary: A cozy horror, “self-coop”, adventure about two unlikely souls who forge a forbidden bond and journey together to find the sun. Explore eerie yet charming Tim Burton-esque levels, switch between two unique characters, and solve brain-teasing puzzles.

name: Fear Effect
summary:
It can recognize fear… can you?
Fear Effect, the pioneering cel-shaded cinematic action game, returns!

Immerse yourself in this intense thriller featuring revolutionary Motion FX technology where you direct your cast of 3D characters within dynamic, full-motion-video worlds. Who lives? Who dies? Only you decide if you can control your fear.

name: Long Drive North
summary: Explore and survive the harsh American wilderness in the Long Drive North. Drive and repair your trusty old RV, scavenge for parts, hunt and cook to survive; all alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. No zombies or monsters await – just an immersive driving-exploration-survival experience.

name: Becoming Saint
summary: Choose your doctrine and preach across medieval Italy in this real-time strategy roguelike. Gather your diverse cast of followers, venture out to convince and convert new believers, conquer towns, and strive to become a saint in your lifetime — or die trying.

name: Deck of Haunts
summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

name: White Knuckle
summary: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

name: Vile: Exhumed
summary: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

name: The Basement Ritual
summary: The Basement Ritual is a short indie horror game where you have been kidnapped and must escape a cult’s basement premises solving puzzles and hiding from a demonic creature.

name: Steel Knight's Armis
summary: "Steel Knight's ARMIS" is a roguelike robot game. Lead the rebellion through five chapters, fighting against the Imperial Army and Earth Federation. Customize and upgrade your robot to survive the intense battles ahead.

name: Garten of Banban 0
summary: Explore the origins of the mysterious Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dark past of the establishment. Try to make some friends. Uncover the truth behind the place, and who you are

name: MindsEye
summary: MindsEye is an ever-expanding gameplay experience with a story campaign, endless stream of new playable content delivered regularly, and the power to create your own games with the simple to use building tool.

name: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
summary: Pirates Outlaws 2 is a swashbuckling roguelike deckbuilder. Collect & fuse cards, gather powerful relics and adapt your strategy during each run. Become a reputed pirate, loot the Sea Masters, challenge giant creatures and triumph in the great Arena!

name: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition
summary:
Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition is an expanded version of Monolith Soft’s open-world science fiction role-playing game. Set after Earth is destroyed in an interstellar war, the game follows survivors who crash-land on the alien planet Mira and establish the city of New Los Angeles. Players join the military organization BLADE, explore Mira’s regions, complete missions, recruit party members and later pilot humanoid mechs known as Skells.

Compared with the original Wii U release, the Definitive Edition includes enhanced visuals, interface, and gameplay adjustments, new story elements, and additional content.

name: Kill The Music
summary: Auto-Attack to the Beat of the Music and Hit Rhythm Inputs to boost your Damage! Build up your Solo Meter to trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to mow down hordes of enemies!

name: Eufloria Classic
summary: Eufloria Classic brings back the original charms of the long-unavailable indie classic, updated for a new age with a plethora of new content and features, including extreme moddability.

name: Jupiter Hell Classic
summary: Jupiter Hell Classic is the demake of a remake of a roguelike unmake of a famous 1993 FPS shooter. Rip and Tear!

name: Life is Feudal: Arden
summary: Life is Feudal: Arden is a new, free-to-play MMO set in a brutal medieval world. Challenge fellow feudal lords and ladies, and embark on a journey to conquer uncharted lands. Explore a meticulously hand-crafted map designed to cater to PvP enthusiasts, PvE adventurers, and even those who enjoy the thrill of PvPvE. Fight epic battles, forge alliances, master various professions, trade goods, craft unique items, and build thriving cities or impregnable fortresses. You are the sole driving force for your success!

name: Nightmare Shift
summary: Nightmare Shift is a psychological horror game that follows a female protagonist who starts a new job as a motel receptionist, only to find her life spiraling into a dark and mysterious reality. As she questions her sanity, she must uncover the truth behind the eerie and abnormal events around her.

name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: The Order of Giants
summary: There is a myth of a beast in the hidden depths of Rome, rumored to guard a terrible secret. Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: The Order of Giants DLC is an all-new story chapter that takes Indiana Jones to the ancient streets of Rome where forgotten catacombs twist into something far more sinister. Indy must outwit a dangerous cult and decipher intricate puzzles designed by emperors to uncover the dark legacy of the Nephilim giants.

name: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2
summary: "Cardfight!! Vanguard," has newly come to digital game! Over 3,000 cards for the Standard format! A brand-new original story shares the world of anime series unfolds! Enjoy your own cardfight experience!!

name: Golden Tides
summary:
Set sail in Golden Tides, a fast-paced PvP pirate Adventure MOBA where teams of four race to hunt for treasure. Engage in thrilling ship battles, fight across dynamic terrains, and experience a new adventure every time you set sail.

In Golden Tides, your legacy is forged not just by the treasures you claim but by the choices you make. With true ownership of your achievements, set forth to make your mark on the world. Chart your course, face the unknown, and become the ultimate pirate legend.

name: Islets Defense
summary: Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game where you build a small village to earn resources and defend your castle.

name: These Darker Tides
summary: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!

name: World of Warcraft: The War Within - Undermine(d)
summary: Undermine(d), takes players to an underground city built by the creativity of the goblins.

name: Clutchtime: Basketball Deckbuilder
summary:
A basketball-themed Roguelike Deckbuilder. Each player in a basketball team is represented by 3 skill cards like 2 and 3 point shots, rebounds, steals, blocks, assists, crossover moves. There are also coaching cards like timeouts, challenge or substitution.

The cards are played during a match with a goal of outscoring your opponent. You can play an elimination tournament, or a season where you need to qualify into playoffs.

You can trade cards with other teams, duplicate, remove and upgrade them. You can draft new cards at the end of each quarter and keep one of those permanently at the end of each match.

There's a multiplayer mode as well, where you can play PvP matches when you meat during the competition.

name: Of Ash and Steel
summary: Of Ash and Steel is an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern designs. Explore the lands of a once-prosperous island, hone your combat skills, and survive in the unforgiving realm of the Kingdom of the Seven.

name: Final Fantasy XIV Mobile
summary: An official mobile version of the widely acclaimed MMORPG, developed by Lightspeed Studios!

name: Kaamos
summary: Kaamos is a bite-sized turn-based puzzle roguelike where battles are fought by matching tiles on a grid with looping rows and columns. Build your character and deck of tiles by looting equipment from your foes. Traverse a dark medieval world where the Sun went down and never rose again.

name: Kathy Rain 2: Soothsayer
summary: In this point-and-click urban thriller, down-and-out private eye Kathy Rain will embark on her most dangerous case yet — the pursuit of the notorious serial killer known as the Soothsayer. Find clues, gather evidence, connect the dots, and confront the murderer before the hunter becomes the hunted…

name: Neon Inferno
summary: NYC 2055: a city beyond salvation. Blast your way through this dense cyberpunk jungle in NEON INFERNO, an explosive fusion of 2D run-and-gun and gallery-shooter, and help the Family dominate its streets!

name: Spray Paint Simulator
summary: Sit back, relax and express your creative side in the colorful world of Spray Paint Simulator. Enter the town of Spatterville, meet the locals while you restore, repair, mask and spray paint everything from a kitchen to local landmarks. Buy new equipment, unlock Free Spray and transform the town.

name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.
summary:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 and raises it to new levels! Rollback Netcode support, gorgeous 4K visuals and additional content make it the best version of this legendary game ever.

The legendary fighting series makes its Steam debut with Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.! Challenge the greatest fighters in the world in the ultimate remaster of the classic 3D fighter,now featuring Rollback netcode support, gorgeous 4K graphics, and all the bone-crunching, martial arts combat of the renowned original. Battle through classic VF modes like Arcade or Rank Match, create your own custom online tournaments and leagues with up to 16 players, or learn from the best in Spectator Mode. Master your fighting style to defeat all challengers in the Fifth World Fighting Tournament and become a Virtua Fighter legend!

name: Saga of Guardians
summary: Saga of Guardians is a unique collectible card game and auto battler. Build YOUR deck, place your cards strategically and climb the ranks in the PVP Arena.

name: Winning Post 10 2025
summary: The "Winning Post" series, which celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2023, is an "authentic horse racing simulation game" in which players take on the role of an owner-breeder (horse owner and producer) and experience the drama of horses and people in the horse racing world.

name: Beyond Citadel
summary: Beyond Citadel is an anime style retro throwback shooter inspired by the classics of the 90's, with realistic gunplay mechanics, anime violence and fast paced combat. Fight your way through the heavily armed mechanical fortress and discover the secret that lies beneath.

name: SpreadCheat
summary: SpreadCheat is a puzzle game that fuses intricate spreadsheet challenges with a comedic, 90s financial vibe in a retro Windows 3.11 setting. The Player takes on the role of the new office prodigy, solving absurd tasks and manipulating spreadsheet cells to hit specific targets using clever formulas.

name: HR Simulator
summary: An HR management simulator about navigating workplace dynamics, hiring and training a diverse workforce, and balancing professional growth with personal life in a bustling cityscape.

name: Batography
summary: Play as a curious bat on his mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon. Run, Climb, Glide and Snap your way through an array of obstacles while interacting with the cheeky characters in the neighborhood. Can you collect all ten moon cakes?

name: 1989 After the War
summary: An atomic war has reduced the world to a heap of ruins. However, there are still those who refuse to give up and seek to bring justice even in this chaos. Use your blade, granades and shotgun to fight your way through this post-apocalyptic scrolling action-platformer in pure 80s arcade style.

name: Rusty Dudes
summary: Assemble a team to complete various missions, while fighting off hordes of freaks. In your will be available two dozen unique mercenaries with different skills. Combine them at your discretion.

name: Echoes of the Architects
summary: Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.

name: Fish Shop Simulator
summary: Manage your own aquarium shop in a cozy neighborhood of New York. Buy and sell fish, aquariums, and decorations to friendly customers. Create beautifully decorated aquariums and make a profit by selling them!

name: Ever 17: The Out of Infinity
summary: An remastered version of Ever17 for PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and PC.

name: Deadcam
summary: DEADCAM is a 80's and 90's inspired psychological survival horror game based around found footage presented as "recordings". These recordings serve as a collection of short, self-contained experiences, each set in their own location featuring unique entities, monsters and creatures.

name: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
summary: Passant is a chess roguelike. Gather powerful pieces, items to win unwinnable games and badges which can provide power-ups and change how the game is played.

name: Katanaut
summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

name: Pair a Dice
summary: Pair A Dice is a Co-Op Dice Roller where you harness the power of magic dice to create enemies, craft items, and defeat bosses!

name: Unprotected
summary: He asked only for your help. For humanity left unprotected, you are the only hope. Can you uncover the secrets and set everything right?

name: Shard Squad
summary: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

name: Nomad Idle
summary: Face waves of enemies automatically and create builds by distributing stat points, leveling up equipment, choosing passive skills, summons, on-hit effects, and more. An idle game about killing hordes of enemies, becoming stronger, and exploring an unfolding storyline. A spin-off of Nomad Survival.

name: 1000 Princes
summary: 1000 Princes is a female-oriented 3D visual novel romance game. A fracture in your timeline has caused all your prince husbands—spanning past, present and future from different settings—to time-travel to your current era. Now1,000 princes coexist on your shared timeline, protecting and adoring you.

name: Mu: Dark Epoch
summary: MU: Dark Epoch is a fantasy MMORPG mobile game that combines high quality, fast-paced gameplay, and innovative features. As the best MU Installment in the series by far, it offers impressive dynamic costumes and stunning graphic performance.

name: Rogue Loops
summary: Rogue Loops is a roguelite action game where a trapped family battles to escape an endless loop. Combine unique skills and relics to create powerful synergies against the loop’s guardians. As you grow stronger, so does the loop—can you break free from this relentless cycle?

name: Rivenaar's Grove
summary: Harvest ingredients for potions to prove your worth as the apprentice of a skilled magician!

name: Urbex Murder
summary: Urbex Murder is a cooperative horror game where you explore abandoned places alone or with friends. Solve puzzles, confront events, and uncover hidden secrets. Each map offers unique scenarios for an immersive and terrifying experience.

name: Grand Mountain Adventure 2
summary: Grab your skis or snowboard and explore massive open-world resorts. Ride at your own pace, take on slalom, slopestyle, and downhill challenges, or try out activities like paragliding, ziplining, wakeboarding, and longboarding. Carve your own path!

name: Evil Timefall
summary: Evil Timefall - hardcore FPS, where you fight against medieval evil. Immerse yourself in dark horror, where you kill zombie knights, witches and demons. Dive into the meat slaughter, where cruel enemies attack you from the darkness. Upgrade guns to execute more servants of the bloody lord.

name: Vextorial
summary: Vextorial is a mind-bending puzzle-platformer where you swap between 2D and 3D perspectives and twist gravity itself to solve impossible puzzles, explore a surreal, ancient ruin suspended in shifting dimensions, and uncover a mystery only you can piece together.

name: Freddy Farmer
summary: Freddy Farmer is a retro arcade style game with 16-bit pixel art graphics in the style of the 80s/90s where you can test your skills as a player.

name: Nubby's Number Factory
summary: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

name: Newton
summary: Newton is a pixel art platformer. Collect apples, master gravity and set high scores in this simple but challenging adventure!

name: Heroes of the Seven Islands
summary: A party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Seven Islands is a comfy yet challenging adventure with side quests in a vast fairytale world, inspired by 90s games.

name: Hell Clock
summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

name: Conquest Dark
summary: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.

name: Nedra
summary: NEDRA is a story-driven, atmospheric action-adventure blending survival horror with cosmic terror. Set in a Soviet-era Antarctic station, all the explorers have vanished without a trace, leaving you to uncover the chilling truth.

name: Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator
summary: Step into the world of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner: Prologue, where you create unique recipes, manage your restaurant, and satisfy customers. Unlock ingredients, design your menu, and start your journey toward becoming a top Restaurant Manager. Your culinary adventure begins here!

name: Aris Arcanum
summary: Clyde Colergrave is a Librarian, laboring away in the Aris Archives. Bound by his Knowledge, he is trapped with the festering Ink among the occult stacks of Aris. A unique Victorian roguelite awaits, where a desperate scholar uses Atramancy, the Magic of Ink, to spellcraft his way to salvation...

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
summary: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up.

name: Starlight Re:Volver
summary: Dive into vibrant dream worlds, where every adventure brings you closer to Nishi stardom. Team up to unleash explosive combos and defeat powerful foes. Then, unwind in the lively city of NIM, where you can hang-out, craft and relax with friends.

name: Chains of Freedom
summary: Embark on a thrilling journey in a high-stakes, turn-based tactics game. Lead an elite squad in a fictional, dystopian Eastern Europe as you unravel a sinister conspiracy threatening the nation. Navigate intense strategic battles and adapt to ever-evolving challenges to prevail.

name: Empyreal
summary: Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG. In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation.

name: And Roger
summary: It was a morning like all others, until she realized her dad wasn't home. In his place, a stranger who speaks nonsense and insists she "takes her medicine". Who is he? Where is dad?

name: Sofia in Exchange for Lies
summary: Peek into the sins and memories of five personalities through surveillance cameras. This is an immersive, mystery adventure game that unravels the thoughts of the dark past that lie dormant inside Sofia, a suspect in the murder of a presidential candidate, and uncovers the truth behind the crime.

name: The Headliners
summary: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 4 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

name: Do No Harm
summary: A Doctor Simulator with a Lovecraftian twist. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

name: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
summary: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with The Talos Principle: Reawakened - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

name: Nice Day for Fishing
summary: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

name: Atomic Heart: Enchantment Under the Sea
summary: Enchantment Under the Sea goes back to the spectacular combat gameplay that made Atomic Heart one of the highlights of 2023, as players continue the main storyline with the Twins’ consciousness at their side and new weapons in their arsenal. Meet new and returning characters while diving into the mysteries of the underwater Neptune Research Center to find a way to save humanity from a dismal future. Players will also revisit familiar locations from Facility 3826 that have changed beyond recognition, like the flying city of Chelomey, now under the robots’ total control.

name: Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse)
summary: A first-person, narrative-driven game featuring The Developer, who questions, taunts, and tests you at every turn. You shouldn’t press the button, but you’ll want to. You will have control, and you will have none. Power is in your hands... or is it?

name: RuneQuest: Warlords
summary: RuneQuest: Warlords is a battle-scale turn-based strategy game set in the Runequest universe. Immerse yourself in the rich lore of Glorantha. Become a warlord, master the use of runes and defend your tribe against the incursions of Chaos. Field an army drawing from heroes and creatures.

name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
summary: When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

name: Little Rocket Lab
summary: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

name: Locomoto
summary: Locomoto is a cozy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

name: Kentum
summary: Stranded in the year 10,000, Kent—an average Joe turned clone—must survive, explore, and rebuild civilization with the help of a snarky AI. Craft, farm, and automate in this 2D craftervania adventure as you uncover Earth’s secrets and kickstart humanity, one machine at a time.

name: Go Slimey Go!
summary: Go Slimey Go! is an easy-to-pick-up game for players of all ages! Help Slimey, our tiny slippery protagonist, visit his friends for some well deserved teatime after some thrilling platforming challenges! Just make sure not to get caught in the middle of the ultimate showdown between good and evil!

name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
summary: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

name: Class of Heroes 3: Remaster
summary: The classic, school-based 3D dungeon-crawling RPG is back! After a 15-year wait, the third installment in the series comes to the West, with new features, more characters, classes, and bigger dungeons.

name: Bambas!
summary: Relive your childhood and turn every crosswalk, curb, and puddle into an epic adventure with this innovative urban walking simulator.

name: Kingdom Flipper
summary: Grab a broom and hammer, it’s time to flip castles! Take drab strongholds and transform them into palaces fit for royalty. Take jobs, buy land, and build your dream castle all for profit, of course!

name: A Game About Digging A Hole
summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

name: Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound
summary: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

name: Shadow Labyrinth
summary: Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic PAC-MAN. As The Swordsman, you wake on a mysterious planet amidst relics of wars past. To survive you will discover secrets, consume your enemies, and grow from prey to apex predator.

name: Steel Paws
summary: Embark on a dynamic action adventure game as a girl alongside her buddy robots to conquer a mysterious tower that reappears every century.

name: Rematch
summary: Control one player on your team and compete in fast-paced 5v5 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Team up with your friends and join the action.

name: Elden Ring Nightreign
summary: Elden Ring: Nightreign is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

name: Split Fiction
summary: Split Fiction is a 2025 cooperative multiplayer game. It follows two writers, Mio Hudson and Zoe Foster, as they become trapped in their imaginations.

name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
summary:
Enter the world of the HBO hit series, Game of Thrones.
Experience an open-world action RPG with an original story found only in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad!

name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
summary: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

name: Dispatch
summary: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

name: Escape Simulator 2
summary: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

name: Void Sails
summary: Void Sails is a single-player adventure where you captain a flying ship across uncharted space. Sail through mysterious worlds, battle powerful foes, and make story-defining choices. Uncover dark secrets in a game where every discovery could bring you closer to the truth—or to madness.

name: The Scouring
summary: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use modding tools to create custom game modes! Join The battle!

name: Desktop Survivors 98
summary: Desktop Survivors 98 is a chaotic roguelite dungeon crawler that unfolds right on your Desktop. Take control of your cursor as you explore new rooms, battle relentless waves of enemies, and collect powerful new weapons.

name: Stay: Forever Home
summary: A magical friend - who won't dig holes in your backyard. Ember's not your average pet! She weaves delight into your life and invites you to share her extraordinary world.

name: Pachinko TD
summary: Pachinko TD is a physics-based, minimalist tower defense game. Inspired by Thronefall.

name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
summary: CLoserLook: Old Ways, a captivating interactive story VR adventure game set in modern day west Africa. Awakening in a locked university administrative building, you'll need to solve a series of intricate puzzles to find your way out. As you navigate through the game, explore secret locations and uncover a gripping narrative that delves into themes of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

name: Steel Swarm: Apocalypse
summary: SSA is a next-gen MOBA: 5 vs 5 players fight in 3 lanes to destroy enemy HQ. Yet, SSA advances the genre: Battle enemy heroes weaving through swarms, explore the jungle accomplishing missions, enhance your build with mods and upgrades, and demolish the city to forge new paths altering the map.

name: Foxes' Festival
summary: Travel around town completing mini-games to help the villagers get ready for the fall festival in the evening.

name: Terminull Brigade
summary: Rise in the virtual rebellion to free the Nullverse in this action-packed roguelike game together with other players, or alone. Master your Rogueteers with distinct playstyles and customizable builds and break out from the binaric destiny with the Terminull Brigade.

name: Claire a la Mode
summary: Team up with a friend or go it alone into a sugar-high adventure! Bake your dessert masterpiece and collect new bakers as you rise through a high-stakes bake-off full of cheaters. Fend off their decadent lackeys and against all odds, come out on top in a worldwide baking frenzy!

name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
summary: Bendy: Lone Wolf will tests your ability to survive against ever increasing odds. Monsters and obstacles emerge from every direction as you journey into the rubberhose halls of the world's most evil animation studio. Every day is a challenge.

name: Greed Stays Home
summary: A horror walking sim that emphasizes atmosphere, tension, fear, and immersive storytelling, all heightened by well-timed jump scares. The game takes place in a village frozen in time, stuck somewhere in the mid-20th century.

name: Tinkerlands
summary: Explore, craft, and fight your way on the uncharted islands solo or in co-op! Tinkerlands is an exciting survival adventure where you will build your settlement, craft useful tools to survive, and even use magic!

name: Super Sorry
summary: You play as a salaryman who gets caught in various everyday troubles and overcomes them with acrobatic bows. From boss reprimands to client complaints and family issues, showcase your elegant apology skills across different scenarios. What shocking ending awaits?

name: Karen Ready！
summary: You run your own perfume store as the owner of a perfume store. A sudden accident has involved you in the investigation of your own resurrection from the dead. The truth gradually emerges with three employees - a love affair about perfume. Harvest the memories of your own heartbeat in the game!

name: Stella Sora
summary: In this top-down, light-action adventure game developed by Yostar, play as the Tyrant in a captivating fantasy world. Create memorable bonds with charming girls known as Trekkers, assemble perfect teams for diverse adventures, and conquer the mysterious Monoliths. Packed with exhilarating battles, randomized perks each run, and a variety of in-game features, Stella Sora will keep you coming back for more. Tyrant, your legacy awaits!

name: Agatha Christie: Death on the Nile
summary: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into a journey filled with intrigue, deception, and unexpected revelations.

name: Black Armor: Battle For Survivors
summary:
In a world on the brink of chaos, Black Armor, Spicy, Charlie and other heroes fight to maintain balance, while the Grim Reaper and his dark forces threaten to destroy everything. Prepare for a story full of bravery, betrayal and redemption, where every fight counts.

Experience the most visceral and challenging combat. Don't miss it!

name: Moony: Black_Lotus
summary:
In a world of corrupted memories, you traverse the remains of a once flourishing city. Shadows flicker around you and metallic echoes pulse through your mind. Search for your father's legacy to regain your forgotten past. But beware! Each step takes you deeper into a waking nightmare.

In this side-scroller adventure, navigate the remains of a once thriving civilization and piece together your scattered past. Between classical jump-n-run and puzzle solving, you have to keep a close eye on your surroundings. Explore the depths as you uncover forgotten stories and concealed corruption. On your journey, you must face the truth about your past life while reclaiming the essence of yourself.

name: A Coloring Break
summary: Fill the blank patterns with colors and take a coloring break on paper.

name: Mall Simulator
summary: Turn your building from a small shopping center into a huge city mall! To avoid going bankrupt, you’ll need to build new stores and restaurants, set smart prices, and keep up with trends. 15+ stores, dozens of machines & services, and hundreds of famous brands waiting for you...

name: Football Life Simulator
summary: Live the life of a professional footballer both on and off the field. Train, play matches, manage your social life, climb the career ladder, and spend your earned money. Decorate your life with luxury while managing your relationships and finances.

name: Bank Simulator
summary: Bank Simulator puts you in charge of a dynamic bank, from developing sections and overseeing transactions to making strategic investments. Build customer loyalty, expand services, and manage financial risks to grow your bank into a top financial institution where every decision counts!

name: Puzkin: Magnetic Odyssey
summary: PUZKIN: Magnetic Odyssey invites players to explore a vibrant, magical world where magnetic energy sustains the balance of nature and creatures called Puzzies. Players, embodying chosen children, are transported to this mysterious realm to restore its harmony through epic adventures, collaborative construction, and immersive quests.

name: Ys X: Proud Nordics
summary: Stand Proud for a new adventure in Ys X: Proud Nordics! Experience Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf with new quality of life improvements, then discover the new story centering around Öland Island, and the mysterious newcomers Canute and Astrid. And once you're ready, challenge yourself in the devious, time-trial dungeon of Muspelheim, where every second counts. Your new adventure awaits!

name: Space Engineers 2
summary: Space Engineers 2 is an open world sandbox game where engineering meets exploration, construction, and survival in the vastness of space. Become a pioneer in the distant Almagest system, a new uncharted world with infinite possibilities for creativity and discovery. Build everything from starships to space stations as you craft your own path in this highly anticipated next chapter of the Space Engineers series!

name: Pathologic 3: Quarantine
summary: Pathologic 3: Quarantine is a narrative-driven adventure about a young scientist in search of immortality and a mysterious plague outbreak in a small town. Learn how your story began and what drove a celebrated academic to leave his acclaimed lab. Examine patients, uncover strange secrets, and make first steps towards defeating Death.

name: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga
summary:
Finally, the walls between Falcom's legendary RPG series, Ys and Trails, are broken for the ultimate dream match up! Fan-favorite heroes and rivals clash in battles once thought impossible, with support from beloved characters across Falcom's classic titles to aid you in the fight!

This new version of the PSP title features remastered graphics, online multiplayer, English translation and voice acting, and other new features.

name: Off
summary: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

name: Bearly Escape
summary:
Wild animals should roam free, but Kidd, a deranged scientist (the game’s antagonist), ventures into the forest to capture animals and use his twisted “X Serum,” he freezes the animals and subjects them to extraction and compression devices that strip away their consciousness, trapping it inside dolls. These dolls are then stuffed into claw machines, imprisoning the creatures in a nightmarish state.

As the protagonist, you ( a forest protection volunteer) lead a peaceful life in Everwood, a town nestled near the forest—until one day, your beloved dog, Robin, goes missing. This leads you to discover Kidd’s sinister lab, where you discover his horrific experiments. Now, it’s up to you to embark on a daring mission: free the trapped consciousness of the animals, rescue them from the claw machines, and help them escape the clutches of Kidd’s evil control, venture dangerously through forest terrane to escape, ultimately returning them to their natural habitat.

The stakes are high, and time is running out. The wild is calling. It’s time to claw your way to justice!

name: Road59: A Yakuza’s Last Stand
summary: Born as the heir to a crime syndicate, yet longing for an ordinary and peaceful life, the kind-hearted protagonist fights desperately to protect their loved ones. Set against a backdrop of towering skyscrapers, this visual novel weaves together the lives of 23 characters in a modern-day legend.

name: Tower Wizard
summary: Help a wizard construct the mightiest wizard tower in this short incremental game!

name: Wind Fantasy: NeXus
summary:
Wind Fantasy:NeXus is a TBS game.
In collaboration with 10 Taiwan's popular VTuber in depth into the cooperation, tailored to create a dedicated main storyline and permanent presence in the game, the player will be together with them in the world of wind fantasy, and the legendary heroes together to embark on an epic adventure

name: Heinz Honor and Revenge
summary: Heinz Honor & Revenge is a beat 'em up game that offers an action-packed experience with a deep story and challenging puzzles. Players will take on the role of Heinz, a secret agent fighting for his country against various threats from ruthless criminal syndicates.

name: Megabonk
summary: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Grab loot, level up, unlock characters and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!
