name: Good Coffee, Great Coffee
summary: Wake up and smell the coffee because TapBlaze's newest simulation cooking game, Good Coffee, Great Coffee, is finally here! Prepare delicious drinks, experiment with new flavors, decorate your shop, and manage cafe costs to become the best barista in town!

name: Threefold Recital
summary: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms. A 2D platformer with puzzles.

name: Terminator 2D: No Fate
summary: Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

name: Cursed Digicam
summary: You receive a cursed digital camera that captures ghosts from a strange website. The website allows you to liberate your loved ones by uploading images of their spirits using the camera. You decide to go to the nearest park where your girl was last seen.

name: Fitness Fables
summary: A fantasy world where fitness becomes an adventure. Fitness Fables turns your workouts into story-driven quests, combining fun challenges with beautiful, immersive environments.

name: Stimulation Clicker
summary: Stimulation Clicker is a fast-paced clicker game where players click a button to accumulate "stimulation" points. These points can be used to automate point collection and unlock various upgrades and achievements. The game intentionally overloads the player with visual and auditory stimuli, mirroring the chaotic nature of the modern internet.

name: Black Beacon
summary: Black Beacon is an action-packed RPG set in a world where ancient prophecies come to life. After the arrival of the "Seer," a mysterious black monolith known as the "Beacon" activates, unleashing strange anomalies around the Tower of Babel. These anomalies are far from mythical—they hide powerful secrets that could reshape humanity's future.

name: Amenti
summary: A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.

name: Sit-Back Attack
summary:
Sit-Back and Relax while the game grinds for you!
It is an Idle RPG WITHOUT any MTX!

Features 60+ different classes, 500+ different skills, unlimited amount of build options to help make the team of 4 heroes you control defeat over 300 monsters!

A very in-depth interface that allows you to see every facet of battle, stats, and more to help you decide how to make your team even stronger!

All classes have unique character art and their own skills, strengths, and weaknesses.

You can choose from 1 of 4 pets to help bolster your team and you control when it uses it's special attack.

An alchemy craft that allows you to use potions on your allies and enemies manually! This craft can be improved with a characters skills and gear.

So much more!

name: Maze Mice
summary: Maze Mice is a bullet heaven roguelite where time only moves when you move. Collect dots, level up, choose upgrades, and avoid cats. All at your own pace.

name: Puck
summary:
Puck is a multiplayer hockey game that trusts the player to do the hard work. The puck has weight and momentum, so plays are never automatic. A pass that looks perfect can skid wide if you misjudge speed or angle, and a shot that seems routine can bounce off the post in a heartbeat. That unpredictability is the point. It makes every successful play feel earned and every mistake teachable.

Controls are deliberately precise rather than flashy. Small adjustments to stick angle and body position change outcomes in meaningful ways. You learn to read the ice, to nudge the puck into space, to sell a fake with your shoulders and then thread a pass through a seam. Goaltending is its own discipline. Good goalies win games by staying calm, cutting angles, and trusting timing instead of spamming saves.

name: Moorhuhn VR Blast
summary: Get ready to blast Moorhuhn like never before with “Moorhuhn VR Blast!” Feel the unique blend of new and nostalgic vibes as you enter Virtual Reality. Test your shooting skills in a variety of reinvented versions of the classic levels you know and love. Every level offers new challenges and new weapons to unlock. With various game modes, challenges, and leaderboards, “Moorhuhn VR Blast” offers endless hours of fun. Compete with friends to become the ultimate blaster!

name: Null State
summary:
Null State is a moddable CRPG built on classic gameplay styles and themes found in cyberpunk games from the late 80s and early 90s.

Inspired by classic cyberpunk stories (& other, older tales of downtrodden folk heroes), you will be tasked with helping the people in your community until you discover that your world is barely holding together — and about to be pushed over the brink.

name: The House of the Dead 2: Remake
summary: The House of the Dead 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

name: JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator
summary: JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator is a quirky and humorous simulation game that lets players step into the shoes of JoshGeoff's unique worker, a character navigating through bizarre cities and locations. Set in the UK, the game blends elements of exploration and interaction with an emphasis on comedic storytelling and quirky dialogue. Players are tasked with completing unusual challenges, all while collecting things for your boss.

name: Gas Station Manager
summary: An ultimate 1-4 player Co-op Simulation game where you build and manage your gas station completely from scratch. Team up with your friends, provide exceptional service and grow your business! Collaboration (and some chaos!) is the key to success—fuel up, have your fun and rise to the top!

name: Black Mesa: Military
summary: Experience the consequences of the resonance cascade scenario once again, and play as one of Hazardous Environments Combat Unit marines, Steven Mills. You are not a survivor, you are sent on a mission. Secure Black Mesa Research Facility with the rest of your squad and eliminate any hostile forces. This mod is not a recreation of any existing mods. It's the mod developers own creation and all maps and plot are being developed by them. You will experience Black Mesa disaster from a perspective of the villains and even see Gordon Freeman in person.

name: Epyka
summary: Epyka is an adventure, puzzle, narrative VR caper into the mysteries and blunder of a forgotten society. Reveal secrets by deciphering clues, decoding hidden messages, and revealing veiled pathways on your quest to finish what your father started and finding out what happened to the world's first civilization. The game's short length and squabble from characters doesn't diminish the fact that Epyka is incredibly charming and the gameplay is so intriguing all the way through that your only complaint might be that you want more.

name: Unaccessible
summary: Unaccessible is a third-person wheelchair platformer about struggling to get a health insurance claim approved on a mysterious island without accessibility ramps. Tackle stairs, climb obstacles and hop your way through the pain of the claims approval process.

name: Wartorn
summary: Harness the elements in fierce real-time battles while gathering and upgrading a crew of fantasy creatures in this rogue-lite adventure across a world torn apart by war.

name: Tower Dominion
summary: In this roguelike tower defense, repel waves of enemies by shaping the paths, customizing your defense and adapting your strategy to crush the invading swarms. No two playthroughs are the same and each strategic decision in this treacherous world could lead to survival or utter defeat.

name: Öoo
summary: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs! In this game, you play as a bomb-wielding caterpillar, progressing through stages by cleverly using your body (which is made of bombs).

name: PGA Tour 2K25
summary: The master of golf sims is back! Tee off with the world’s top golfers on the most storied courses on golf’s biggest stages.

name: Suikoden I HD Remaster: Gate Rune War
summary: Remaster of the first Suikoden game, released as part of the Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars bundle.

name: Suikoden II HD Remaster: Dunan Unification War
summary: Remaster of the second Suikoden game, released as part of the Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars bundle.

name: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete
summary: Remaster of the complete version of Lunar: Silver Star Story, released as part of the Lunar Remastered Collection bundle.

name: Tentacle Tango
summary: Tentacle Tango is a quirky co-op puzzle-platformer where you and a partner must work together, tethered by a flexible tentacle. Don’t let the cute visuals fool you—this game is as challenging as it is charming. Every jump, swing, and tentacle bend requires precise coordination as you navigate puzzles, obstacles, and enemies. Whether playing solo or in local co-op, teamwork is your only path to victory, because after all, it takes two to tango!

name: Perplex
summary: A neon-themed 2D puzzle platformer where you navigate intricate levels, solve physics-based challenges, and avoid obstacles to reach the portal. Play solo or with a friend in a visually stunning retro-futuristic world that tests your precision and strategic thinking.

name: Look Outside
summary:
Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in. Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
DONT LOOK OUTSIDE

A survival horror RPG by Francis Coulombe, with music by Eric Shumaker, made in one month for the Hawktober game jam.

name: Julian & Friends
summary: Join Julian and his friends in this psychological horror experience inspired by point-n-click computer games from the early 2000s. Witness many shenanigans with characters from the infamous 98xx.

name: 10 Seconds Dash!
summary: Ten-Second Takeover! is a 2D jumping action game with an extremely short time limit of 10 seconds to enjoy a new sense of tension and achievement. Enjoy the ultimate time limit combined with cute character graphics and fast-paced music.

name: Hungry Meem
summary: Meems, the hungry creatures that live under the World Tree, are in danger of extinction! Let's make the Meems' lives happy by exploring around the World Tree with them and developing their settlement!

name: Kamitsubaki City Virtual Reality
summary: Dark-fantasy science fiction VR adventure game sharing the same basic story as Kamitsubaki City Regenerate.

name: Death Howl
summary: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

name: Schedule I
summary: Schedule I is a first-person open-world crime simulation game where players build and manage a drug trafficking operation in the fictional city of Hyland Point. Gameplay combines business management with tactical strategy, as players grow and manufacture various substances, sell to residents while avoiding police, and expand through hiring employees and purchasing properties. Drugs can be mixed with various ingredients to alter their effects and increase sell value. Players must contend with law enforcement mechanics including random searches, roadblocks, and a wanted system. The game also features an active modding community and cooperative multiplayer.

name: The Fool's Apprentice
summary: A wizard academy management sim where you—an obviously benevolent professor—must manage & cast spells on your many apprentices so that they might study the right spells… and perhaps even survive the researching process. Some may die, but oh well, can’t save them all!

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat
summary: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Christimas-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

name: Penguin Flight
summary: Soar Beyond Your Dreams

name: Toon Breakout 3D
summary: Break Bricks, Smash Characters, and Conquer the Toon World!

name: Infinity Nikki: Firework Season
summary:
As fireworks light up the night sky, a fantastical adventure unfolds on the new event Isles, and a mysterious ship from the Linlang Empire arrives... The grand celebration is about to begin, and Miraland welcomes all stylists!

Reflected in the eyes of The Wishing One, the all-caring Sprite...
A glimmer of sparkle, a touch of luck...
Should you find yourself lost in the depths or adrift in shadow...
He shall deliver the guidance of Whim.

name: Far From The Darkness
summary: A first-person multiplayer game inspired by the Werewolf concept. Depending on your role, investigate and hunt werewolves or betray your squad. Strategize, collaborate, and survive while communicating through proximity chat!

name: Stronghold: Crusader - Definitive Edition
summary: Gird your loins and sharpen your steel! Besiege 20 unique enemy lords and battle friends online, in this expanded remaster of the classic 'castle sim'. Relive history with new units, AI opponents, visuals, audio, campaigns, skirmish trails, co-op and larger maps.

name: Car Detailing & Wash Simulator: Luxury Car Cleaner
summary: Luxury Cars, Flawless Shine – Master the Art of Detailing!

name: LockYourDoor
summary: LockYourDoor is a challenging survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your aim is to survive while you search for your friend Darvin. Try your best to stay alive and confront your nightmares. Only the patient and clever will survive.

name: Chrono Gear: Warden of Time
summary: Turn back the clock and fight to repair Time itself in this cinematic action platformer with fast sword combat and time-based powers. You are the Warden of Time, Ouro Kronii - be proud and fight hard!

name: Grandma, No!
summary: Step into Grandma's slippers in this hilarious, chaotic adventure where chores become challenges, and things always go... a little off-track. Can you keep things under control, or will the house turn into a whirlwind of chaos?

name: Genshin Impact: Moonlight Amidst Dreams
summary:
Version 5.4 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Yumemizuki Mizuki
• New story quest for Yumemizuki Mizuki
• New main event: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

name: Ma vie en rogue
summary: Ma vie en rogue is a roguelike spanning multiple themed dungeons and worlds bringing advancements such as a mini-map, first-person view, and paperdoll customization to the genre.

name: Keziah's Realm
summary: Forage, craft, fight, form clans, and expand your settlements in a dynamic, ever-changing ecosystem. Keziah’s Realm offers a unique gaming experience where you must survive in a rich, procedurally generated world, alongside intelligent NPCs who possess abilities equal to those of the player.

name: Order 13
summary: Pack orders and ship them out. But the warehouse holds more than just inventory.

name: Ninja Gaiden 4
summary: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

name: Ninja Gaiden II Black
summary: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of "NINJA GAIDEN 2," featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

name: EA Sports College Football 26
summary: In EA SPORTS College Football 26, the playbook is yours. Rise from high school recruit to Heisman legend, or cement your legacy as a coach by leading your program to glory.

name: Yes Comrade
summary: Yes Comrade is a 1 - 4 player cooperative survival sandbox where you and your fellow Comrades are re-assigned to a remote sea outpost. Guard the great Belegovskain coastline, process the ships, keep the Supreme Leader happy, and try not to think too hard about what happens on the island…

name: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit
summary: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

name: Donna: The Canine Quest
summary: Embark on a paw-some journey in Donna: The Canine Quest! Dive into a world of heroic hounds, where each thrilling battle and loot discovery keeps the excitement at its peak. With cute pixel-art graphics and satisfying gameplay this tail-wagging adventure will have you barking for more!

name: Boulder Crash
summary: Collect diamonds and avoid monsters! You need to collect all the diamonds to exit the level. Rocks and diamonds can fall and kill you.

name: Idun: Frontline Survival
summary: A defense RTS where you can move turrets at will. Extract resources, upgrade technology, and defend against enemy swarms in a gripping space campaign. Hold the line, set up your turrets, and brace for screen-filling hordes!

name: Mashina
summary: A little robot digs to repair her world. Dig, build, discover and mend in a chill, stop-motion world.

name: Doom: The Dark Ages - Premium Edition
summary:
DOOM: The Dark Ages Premium Edition INCLUDES:
- Base Game
- Campaign DLC **
- Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
- Divinity Skin Pack

**DLC availability to be provided at a later date.

name: Escape from Duckov
summary: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

name: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji
summary:
The first expansion for Assassin's Creed Shadows.
Add over 10 hours of additional content with a new location, quests, enemies and gears.

name: Love, Money, Rock'n'Roll: Summer '94
summary:
7 years have passed. Nikolai's life has changed: he has left much behind and now simply goes with the flow, avoiding stress and upheaval. However, fate has its own plans for our hero! New and old acquaintances will rush into his life like a gust of summer wind, bringing with them long-forgotten emotions and love!

An all-new story taking place across over more than two in-game weeks.

The opportunity to learn what fate befell the characters after the end of the game.

New characters, environments, music tracks, and illustrations.

A chance to see Nikolai from a different perspective and help him find new love.

name: Cubic Odyssey
summary: Embark on a galactic journey in Cubic Odyssey, an open-world adventure where you explore vibrant planets, craft tools, build vehicles, and fight the Red Darkness. Uncover ancient mysteries, and shape a universe full of life, danger, and limitless possibilities!

name: Suspense: Madman's Dreams
summary: This psychological adventure, focused on narrative, is based on a scientific representation of mental disorders. Are you ready to face the fears of people suffering from mental illnesses? Use your voice as the voice of the main character to get as close to them as possible.

name: The Little Moon
summary: Storytelling, Side-scroller, Universe, Travel, Fishing, Action, Adventure.

name: Windborn: Wings of Fate
summary: Soar through the sky and master the wind!

name: Speedrun Academie
summary:
In this first-person game, you’ll need to master every movement, optimize your trajectory, and maintain your momentum if you want to reach the finish. Every level is a challenge where slowing down isn’t an option, and mistakes aren’t forgiven.

Your mission is simple: start at point A, reach point B as fast as possible… but only a true speedrunner can shine.

name: Everspace 2: Wrath of the Ancients
summary: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion DLC as the Cluster readies for war once again in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

name: Electro Bop Boxing League
summary: Climb the ranks and claim your spot among the greatest mechanical fighters in this Atompunk / Electro Swing themed auto-boxer! Outfit your boxer with a variety of parts, abilities, belts and crew upgrades earned through single matches or career mode!

name: Max Manos
summary: Max Manos is an incremental destruction game where you play as a powerful hand, known as Max Manos, eliminating shapes. Chain explosive reactions, collect shards, and upgrade your abilities to destroy shapes even faster.

name: Out of the Park Baseball 26
summary: 26 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 26 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc., and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your way, your rules.

name: Collect Baby Oil
summary: Collect Baby Oil is a fast-paced runner where you have to run away from the police. Collect bottles of baby oil scattered along your path to unlock a variety of funny and unique characters such as Quandale Dingle. Avoid obstacles, time your jumps perfectly, and see how far you can go before the cops catch up.

name: WWE 2K25
summary: Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online in MyGM. Expanded gameplay includes intergender wrestling, chain wrestling, barricade diving, the return of Promos + much more!

name: Scar-Lead Salvation
summary: Hard difficulty TPS roguelike with randomly generated dungeons. The protagonist, Willow Martin, has no memory of her past, but when a fight begins, her body moves naturally and she displays exceptional combat abilities.

name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
summary:
The Librarian Ariana’s mission is to repair the Seven Hero Codices, which have been altered. Due to the terrible damages, magic has vanished from the world.

By utilizing special Librarian magic that allows her to enter Codices, Ariana seeks to mend the books to bring back magic. Can Ariana safely repair each tome and unravel the mysteries hidden within the Library?

name: The Bench
summary: Relax on a park bench, find hidden objects, solve quirky puzzles, and fend off pesky pigeons in this charming, interactive adventure. Enjoy beautifully stylized, colorful levels keeping you entertained!

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam
summary: Casey Jones joins the fight in this fast-paced, action-packed DLC! Battle through the Junkyard, face new enemies and bosses, and collect new powerful artifacts. Master Casey's hard-hitting moves and team up with the Turtles in co-op to take on the Punk Frogs!

name: MLB The Show 25
summary: Forge your baseball journey in The Show

name: Is This Seat Taken?
summary: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

name: The Sims 2: Legacy Collection
summary: The game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime. Give them a long existence or leave their lives in shambles. Guide their characteristics from one generation to the next.

name: Jumpers League
summary: A competitive online multiplayer platformer where every jump is a gamble. Climb to the top while using strategic abilities to outsmart your opponents, but beware: one misstep can cost you all your progress.

name: Hoover Heroes
summary: Hoover Heroes is a physics-based multiplayer party game for up to 8 players to play online, featuring cute and silly cleaners. Funny animations, colorful graphics, and fun mechanics will keep you laughing every moment.

name: Beyond Blue: After the Storm
summary: After a severe tropical storm damages an underwater research station, Mirai and her crew are asked to help repair the damage and lend aid to the creatures in the surrounding biosphere. What they uncover there is more dangerous than they could have realized and will take all their skills, and help from an unexpected ally, to make right.

name: Guilty as Sock!
summary: Enter a chaotic courtroom where socks play lawyers, prosecutors, and judges! Use absurd evidence, craft wild arguments, and deliver verdicts in this hilarious online party game. Improvise, strategize, and shout "Objection!"—because in Guilty as Sock!, chaos always wins!

name: Auto-Crisis
summary: You're driving away on a forest road, late at night, under a heavy storm. Your car breaks down. Luckily, there might be a gas station nearby. But a misfortune never comes alone. The storm has brought something else, something otherworldly that oddly smells of spilled diesel oil.

name: Unmourned
summary: Unmourned is a first person psychological horror game where you play as Jason, a man who moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal activities. As the disturbances grow more intense, Jason discovers that the house's previous owners mysteriously vanished. Driven by terror and desperation, Jason must uncover the truth behind the family’s disappearance and find a way to break the curse that now haunts him. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

name: Military Incremental Complex
summary:
Make weapons, make money.

Start your own military industrial complex enterprise! Begin by making bullets by hand, then with machines, then acquire entire factories. Expand into making guns, tanks, planes, and even nukes. Research new products, faster and cheaper ways to make them, and better methods of making money. Enter the stock market to raise capital, buyout rival companies, or perform market manipulation. Lobby the government for fewer regulations, better contracts, and more demand for your products. Turn the entire economy into a weapons making machine, making you ludicrous amounts of money.

name: Shelldom
summary: In Shelldom, snails worship alcohol—a drink they love but one that kills them. Their cults sacrifice their own for more, trapped in a doomed cycle. But legend speaks of the Holy Water, hidden atop a merciless tower. Can you climb, endure, and break the curse? Or will you fall like the rest?

name: Bleach: Soul Resonance
summary:
BLEACH: Soul Resonance is a 3D action game that immerses players in thrilling sword-fighting battles. Roleplaying as Ichigo Kurosaki, players will wield their powerful Zanpakuto as they lose themselves in an original storyline while fighting alongside friends and growing stronger. The game features smooth swordplay, diverse battle strategies, and gameplay mechanics like collecting and developing multiple characters and teaming up with others for battles.
As BLEACH fans ourselves, we are honored to have the chance to develop a game for the franchise we love. We are committed to expressing our passion and love with this labor of love, and we hope that more people will discover its charm and experience it for themselves.

name: Montezuma's Revenge: The 40th Anniversary Edition
summary: The 1983 classic multi-room platformer Montezuma’s Revenge returns in 2.5D glory, and now Pedro’s adventure is bigger than ever with 100 tricky rooms to explore! For its 40th anniversary, what was once an unfinished game is now resurrected to match the full vision of creator Robert Jaeger. This time you can choose between male and female explorers, Pedro or his sister Rosita, to delve deep into the dangerous ruins and hunt for treasures untold!

name: Code Reactors
summary: Build your own Magic Deck and set off on a quest in this magical battle-packed 2D-action RPG.

name: AquaDream
summary: Guide your anglerfish through intricate underwater mazes. Collect stars, solve puzzles, and avoid perilous obstacles. Experience a captivating deep-sea adventure filled with hidden treasures and mysteries in this immersive aquatic world.

name: Breakout Beyond
summary: Breakout is back! In this neon-drenched take on the classic, you’ll need to literally break through each puzzle by clearing bricks to breach the final goal. Rack up a combo and create spectacular light shows alone or with a friend.

name: One Last Job
summary: One Last Job is a moddable team management game, where you work to build your reputation as a fixer by successfully completing jobs with your crew.

name: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny
summary: Reclaim your destiny. Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny returns with higher resolution graphics and modernised controls to perform issen critical counter attacks and intense swordplay. Experience this dramatic revenge story set in Feudal Japan.

name: Yunashi no Yume
summary: HYPERxFANTASY is an experimental narrative RPG set in a brutalist dystopian underworld teetering on the edge of digital ascension. As Dreamer, players navigate an endless megastructure, using a versatile glider to traverse its vast, abstract spaces and advance non-linear storylines through branching dialogue. Tasked by the enigmatic Executor to "digitize everyone" and save them, players will soon question the cult-like hierarchy of this desolate dreamscape, uncovering a conspiracy at the core of the Singularity itself.

name: Sonic Wings Reunion
summary:
Sonic Wings Reunion is a sequel to the arcade-style shooter SONIC WINGS. The previous version was sold in 1998.

Choose from 8 characters and destroy the mysterious organization “Fatamornagana” that has progressed into the modern world. The scenario changes depending on the combination of characters.

The first new Sonic Wings (Aero Fighters) game in 26 years, with original staff members from the series involved in its planning, production, and oversight. This all-new installment in the classic vertical-scrolling shoot ’em up series is designed for all fans of the genre to enjoy.

name: Cloudheim
summary: Ragnarok shattered the world, the gods have chosen you to shape the next one. Cloudheim is a cooperative action RPG blending crafting with chaotic physics-based combat. Gather your allies, craft your weapons, and upgrade your shop in the sky to bring harmony to a broken realm.

name: Witch’s Gaze: The Vanishing Village
summary: Embark on a mystical quest that blends Slavic folklore with arcane witchcraft, uncover hidden secrets, and rescue a village lost to the shadows in this magical detective visual novel. Oh, and never forget your cat - he might save you!

name: Shieven
summary: Enter the enigmatic Luminora Hospital, where, as a researcher on the brink of ruin, you take on a case that will test your courage. Amidst dark rumors, you will uncover terrifying secrets that have caused those who dared to go too far to disappear.

name: Fellowship
summary: FELLOWSHIP is a multiplayer online dungeon adventure set in an exciting fantasy setting, with endlessly scaling dungeon runs.

name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary:
OXIDE is a mobile multiplayer survival simulator. Players must survive on a deserted island by gathering resources, building bases, crafting weapons, and battling other players, hunger, and wild animals.

Become part of a vast, living world where social interaction is more vital than any guide. Form powerful clans, storm enemy bases, or survive in the shadows, delivering precision strikes. In this game, there are no limits to betrayal or heroism. It’s just you, your craft, and endless real-time PvP.

name: Gemporium
summary: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in Gemporium, a casual mining simulation management game. Keep your finances in check as you juggle a growing gem emporium while simultaneously paying off a generational debt. There's only so much time in the day!

name: Speed Demons 2
summary: Speed Demons 2 is an arcade highway racing game featuring explosive action, breakneck speeds, and very intense TRAFFIC. With a pulse-pounding soundtrack, unique side-scrolling perspectives, and TONS of varied modes, vehicles, and races, Speed Demons 2 is a thrilling blend of speed and chaos.

name: Cast n Chill
summary: Cast n Chill is a cozy idle (and active) fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

name: Easy Delivery Co.
summary: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

name: Static Dread: The Lighthouse
summary: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!

name: Alquiem
summary: Alquiem is a new Medieval RPG in which you will be able to gain strength through numerous classes and talent trees, professions and equipment to face the creatures that inhabit the lands of Odenzur. Its old-school style will remind all browser game fans of a familiar memory of Fighting, Loots and Relaxing.

name: Magic Chess: Go Go
summary: Welcome to Magic Chess: Go Go, the ultimate strategy game combining MLBB heroes with fresh and casual gameplay. It's not about fast mechanics, but about wisdom and a touch of luck! Play anywhere, anytime, and have fun with friends!
